thread.title: Calibration Review Part 5
thread.preview:
Codex has received your completed Rank8Damage6 response (assistant turn 5cc8c83d-ec06-41b4-b4e7-e1c1b06ab85f). The complete return ZIP is preserved locally: 4,912,092 bytes, SHA256 119bfa063012d4c8c870ad6385c680a7c00c153d778c83bad08ae9895ff935d0. Independent local checking passed 559 source/manifest/hash/preservation and exact-replay checks, including all 51 original sources against the actual repository, 11 full context files against their actual prior archives, and all 37 operations forward to the exact MODEL and backward to the original candidate bytes. MODEL is 1,673,824 bytes, SHA256 df8dd333da82c14178d21657e0702671506e1c30d3ed87d5204993ef8061bc90. No downloaded Python was executed. This is an integrity/reconstruction receipt; local semantic review of the six procedures and 12 main/41 branch cases is still underway. Do not count the six as applied or independently accepted yet.

Please now conduct the next separately delivered full Rank7IdentityCasting5 conference from DD_Rank7_Identity_Casting_5_Source_Conference_01.zip: 4,534,073 bytes, SHA256 fad1e1d4b5146782305d94f62194f8856300dde461a2aec4ef1b5b37e61490ec. Its original candidate is 829,217 bytes, SHA256 bdfba569485e0100dadda7ef41b36eb54d810bc2966b547c680836ac1c236766. Read the actual available archive and all 68 complete source files; preserve the original bytes. If the exact archive or a necessary later source is unavailable, identify the exact missing file rather than reconstructing it from summaries.

The five identities are Cast Echo, Meta Surge, Erase from Reality, Sequester and Simulacrum. Review all six native placements, 24 unselected decisions, 11 complete reviewed counterparts, exact DI7 cases/acceptance and actual Mage/feat metamagic evidence. All five remain individually tier C. Fate Echo's narrower eligibility must not silently restrict Cast Echo. Meta Surge must state which actual points, costs and class-use ledgers it waives, and which it does not. Erase, Sequester and Simulacrum need complete source-faithful body, agency, identity/memory, knowledge, clock, gear/custody, resource and lifecycle procedures; preserve their printed promises without invented cosmology or generic foreign-game substitutions.

Return the full proposed operational procedures and all question dispositions, complete source bindings, actual class-access and automatic-feature accounting, at least two complete worked encounters per identity with meaningful independent edge branches, and exact reversible full before/after operations from the bound original to complete successor bytes. Each case should supply the real initial actors and source-qualified external premises, actual timeline/action budget/costs, necessary geometry, RNG, intermediate transitions and expected final state. Distinguish fixture arithmetic/specification checks from engine execution. Keep genuine external content or engine prerequisites explicitly bounded; do not label a missing main-case premise resolved.

Use the exact accepted Companion05, Illusion13, reviewed Control13 plus Control14 Ready-reference update, and owner-selected COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02 in their actual scope. Mass Suggestion's shared nonconcentration 24-hour maximum, combined True Seeing benefits with real occlusion, and Soulburn/Grand Reservoir's scoped base-RP waiver/20 normal HP payment/selected 0–3 recovery stay settled. Rank8Damage6 is a new locally unaccepted proposed package, not general authority. Retain the five independent Companion/Control positive-case holds and all unimplemented full Ready, Shaman Step, active next-healing and downstream expiry obligations.

The owner continues to reserve the separate implementation instruction. Nothing in this request applies canonical gameplay rules, changes the index/registry, or grants release approval. Applied baseline remains 525 reviewed / 323 pending / 249 standalone / 173 interfaces, with 39 accepted-but-unapplied before local Rank8 semantic disposition. Queue47 separately groups 281 of the 323 pending identities, leaving 42 ungrouped rank9 identities; newly prepared rank9 packets remain unsent and are not reviewed by this request.

Progress through checkpoint57 was backed up and verified on GitHub at 0a9c7b2bc9adc0f6773f2cb64e2dbb3296843ccc; all 28,284 expected blobs matched and 27,845 prior tracked entries were retained, with zero tracked deletions. This newly received Rank8 return and follow-up are later local work. Continue the video-game-only, direct-exploration/deep-tactical/companion-work direction with the owner as design authority and sustained AI engineering support.
